question: After binding approval-artifact paths to the approved spec, can the unchanged five-topology static CPU contract execute once without scope drift?

prior_precheck_failure.failure: The runner still hard-coded v1 proposal/data-card paths, so their observed hashes could not match the frozen v2 artifacts.

single_allowed_change.runner_path_resolution: Resolve proposal from spec.config_path and data card from spec.data_card instead of hard-coded v1 paths.
single_allowed_change.path_safety: Require non-empty project-relative existing files and reject absolute paths and parent traversal.

frozen_unchanged_scope.sensor: Open3D 0.19.0 CPU first-return, 16x720, 0.3--50 m, no noise
frozen_unchanged_scope.teacher: Frozen 5 m spline outgoing-heading oracle, 8 degree deduplication, sigma-3-degree 720-bin target
frozen_unchanged_scope.baseline: Frozen RangeExitBaseline; no threshold or parameter tuning

execution_policy: Create one new v2b run directory and execute once. Never reuse or alter the sealed v1 or v2 directories. No retry, alternate seed, mesh repair, keep-best selection, threshold change or second execution.
acceptance_and_evidence: Unchanged five family/replay/seed-separation contracts, five readable perception meshes, 250 anchors, 750 deterministic views, clearance and branch LOS, five constrained shards, five complete maps, thirty all-observation pages, frozen-rule metrics, raw log, immutable RUN_STATE and SHA-256 manifest within 2 h and 2 GB.
stop_rule: Any provenance, topology, mesh, anchor, sensor, determinism, clearance, branch, leakage, evidence, time or disk failure stops and seals the new run without retry.

estimated_cost.compute: One frozen-E1 CPU process; five meshes and 17.28 million primary rays; no GPU, API, simulator or training.

approval.confirmation_reference: 用户在获知 v2 因 runner 硬编码 v1 提案/数据卡路径而没有执行后回复：继续为啥不执行
